data.body: Change 1846 PS2 CI RCA: the Linux-only failure was in the test oracle, not the production context selection. `multiprocessing.get_start_method()` reports the process-wide/default method (`fork` on Linux) and does not identify the context object that constructed the current child, so a child created by `get_context("spawn").Process(...)` could still return `fork`. The corrected cross-platform oracle returns `type(multiprocessing.current_process()).__name__`, which is `SpawnProcess` for the default path and `ForkProcess` for explicit fork injection. Runtime discriminant: exact production mutation from spawn back to fork makes both default-context tests fail with observed `ForkProcess`; restoring spawn makes the grounding suite pass. Focused grounding tests, make lint, and make typecheck pass locally. Amended patchset commit: 3aa814cdcb; repush is queued behind the currently active global Gerrit Verified runs.
